### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and 
linking the relevant issues via the "close" or "ref".

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close #41602

Problem Summary:

### What is changed and how it works?

This PR implements an optimization when adding multiple indexes.

Previously, TiDB scans table records multiple times.  After this PR, TiDB scans only once and extracts all the needed columns. Compared with previous implementation, coprocessor requests cound be greatly reduced.

- [ ] Performance regression: Consumes more Memory

Documentation

issue_context.title: Optimize multi-schema change for `add indexes`
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement
We can combine multiple "add index" operations in a multi-schema change, which will reduce table data scans and accelerate adding indexes speed.
comments: Use https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/41718 to test it, I found the PR will decrease the performance in lightning mode. The bottleneck is lightning's write performance. So close this issue firstly.

review_comments:
It is better to do like this? We can see what changed in function.


```suggestion
	ctx.GetSessionVars().StmtCtx.MultiSchemaInfo.SubJobs = mergeAddIndex(ctx.GetSessionVars().StmtCtx.MultiSchemaInfo.SubJobs)
```
Then we need to allocate another slice to store the result..

```suggestion
		if subJob.Type != model.ActionAddIndex {
			newSubJobs = append(newSubJobs, subJob)
            continue
		}
        ...
```
